mapper.select: SELECT prj_id,use_yn FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id}
SELECT prj_id,use_yn FROM prj.prj WHERE prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM asgn.asgn WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED') AS assignments, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.bill_stg WHERE prj_id=#{id}) AS bill_stages, (SELECT count(*) FROM prj.tk_aloc_line WHERE prj_id=#{id}) AS allocations, (SELECT count(*) FROM cst.drct_expns WHERE prj_id=#{id} AND dev_id IS NULL) AS expenses
mapper.sql: (SELECT count(DISTINCT a.dev_id) FROM asgn.asgn a WHERE a.prj_id=p.prj_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')) AS "assignmentCount"
FROM prj.prj p LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr c ON c.ptnr_id=p.cust_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN mst.bsn_part b ON b.bsn_part_id=p.bsn_part_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.prj_id,p.prj_no,p.prj_nm,p.cust_ptnr_id,p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.prj_stts_cd,p.win_prblt_rt,p.cntrct_dt, p.cntrct_bgn_dt,p.cntrct_end_dt,p.prfm_bgn_dt,p.bsn_part_id,p.stlm_mthd_cd,p.pm_dev_id,p.free_sprt_yn, p.quot_amt,p.init_cntrct_amt,p.trgt_mrgn_rt,p.trgt_cst_amt,p.indty_cd,p.duty_fld_nm,p.prev_prj_id,p.rmrk_desc, p.cur_cntrct_amt,coalesce(p.cur_end_dt,p.cntrct_end_dt) AS cur_end_dt,p.cntrct_mm_qty,p.use_yn, c.ptnr_nm AS "custName", CASE WHEN b.hq_yn='Y' THEN '본사(직접 영업)' ELSE b.bsn_part_nm END AS "partName", d.dev_nm AS "pmName", LEFT JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=p.pm_dev_id WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT skl_cd FROM prj.prj_skl WHERE prj_id=#{id} ORDER BY skl_cd

SELECT p.prj_id AS id,p.prj_no AS no,p.prj_nm AS name,p.cntrct_ty_cd AS type,c.ptnr_nm AS "custName" WHERE p.use_yn='Y' AND p.prj_stts_cd NOT IN ('END','LOST') AND (position(lower(#{q}) in lower(p.prj_no))>0 OR position(lower(#{q}) in lower(p.prj_nm))>0 OR position(lower(#{q}) in lower(c.ptnr_nm))>0) ORDER BY p.prj_no,p.prj_id

SELECT d.dev_nm AS name,coalesce(j.cd_nm,a.job_cd) AS job,a.bgn_dt AS "beginDate",a.end_dt AS "endDate",a.asgn_rt AS "assignmentRate",a.asgn_stts_cd AS status,a.asgn_id FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN mst.dev d ON d.dev_id=a.dev_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND j.dtl_cd=a.job_cd WHERE a.prj_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' ORDER BY a.bgn_dt,a.asgn_id

SELECT h.chg_at AS "changedAt",coalesce(h.clmn_nm,h.data_chg_ty_cd) AS field,h.bfr_val AS before,h.aft_val AS after,'기본 사용자' AS actor FROM sys.data_chg_hist h WHERE h.obj_rec_id=#{id} AND h.tbl_nm IN ('prj.prj','prj.prj_part_hist','prj.bill_stg','prj.tk_aloc_line','cst.drct_expns','prj.cntrct_chg_hist','prj.psn_plan') ORDER BY h.chg_at DESC,h.data_chg_hist_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE prj.prj SET use_yn=#{useYn},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE prj_id=#{id}
